text:
Alex: quick heads-up — PR #5128 (kv cache minor rename + import reorder) is green except for a goimports/gofumpt failure. can someone take the last mile?

Maria: on it, can you paste the linter output?

Alex: sure — CI shows:
```
./pkg/cache/kv_cache.go:8:2: imported and not used: "strings"
cmd/gofumpt: formatting suggested: pkg/cache/kv_cache.go
goimports reported diff on pkg/cache/kv_cache.go
```

Sam: looks like an accidental import lingered after a refactor. should be a one-liner remove.

Jen: I can do a quick patch. prefer a tiny commit or squash into the PR?

Maria: squash would be nicest to keep history clean, but either works. if you push a fix to the branch CI will re-run.

Alex: +1 for squash. also the import groups are slightly out of order per gci config — linter enforces standard, stdlib first, then external, then internal.

Sam: FYI here's what I run locally:
```
gofmt -w ./
goimports -w ./
gci write ./ --skip-generated
```

Jen: ok pushing a tiny commit to the PR branch now. will run the same commands locally first.

Jen: pushed 1768123450-fix-remove-strings and rebased/squashed locally. triggering CI. :rocket:

CI-bot: CI queued for PR #5128 — build 8821 triggered by Jen.

Lintbot: gofumpt check failed on pkg/cache/kv_cache.go: formatting diff detected. (run `gofumpt -w`)

Jen: running gofumpt then re-pushing...

Maria: thanks — once CI passes I'll give the final approval.

Sam: quick nit: rename function GetKV to GetEntry? it reads clearer when used elsewhere. not a blocker tho.

Alex: let's not change names in the same merge; can be a follow-up. keeps churn low.

Jen: CI passed. pulled in and squashed as requested. 

Maria: approving now. :thumbsup: merging in the next merge window (in ~30m) unless anyone objects.

Sam: nope all good from me.

Alex: thanks team — smooth. I'll watch post-merge Canary for 10m.

CI-bot: PR #5128 merged by Maria into main (build 8821).

Alex: note for future: add a small CI step doc in the PR template reminding folks to run gofumpt/goimports locally for go changes. saves churn.

Maria: good call. I'll file a tiny docs PR later today.

Jen: thanks — learning curve getting their import grouping right.
